mkdir.reason: Basic creation is supported; -p and explicit mode changes fail with ENOSYS instead of claiming unsupported permission semantics.

mv.reason: Same-service regular-file rename preserves source open descriptions. Replacing an open destination returns EBUSY; directory moves are unsupported.

rm.reason: Regular and recursive removal are supported. Removing an open file returns EBUSY; root/cwd and nonempty-directory rules remain enforced.

sed.reason: Stream/file-to-stdout editing is supported. -i fails without replacing the original file; unsupported metadata preservation is checked.

awk.reason: Fields, regex, arithmetic/libm, system and command streams use native adapters. Commands remain subject to native argument, child, fd and eight-grant limits.
